english.title: Fail to comply with a notice to enlarge a gate across a highway
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been served with a notice under section 145(1) of the Highways Act 1980 requiring you to

(A)_[enlarge a gate at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) to a width of **(..SPECIFY WIDTH..),]_
(B)_[remove a gate at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..),]_

failed to comply with that notice within 21 days of the service of the notice on you
english.legislation: Contrary to section 145(2) of the Highways Act 1980.
